arguments.summary: The issue with 502s on the checkout page was due to the ingress idle timeout, not a database issue. The certificate alert was not ignored, as the intermediate certificate had expired. Cron jobs ran as scheduled but the container was running on UTC. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, and the cause needs to be investigated. The backlog will be moved and the failed_jobs table will be exported for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the cause of the failed jobs, address any issues, and export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. Do not delete rows; flag them for removal if necessary.
